title: Small and gross color
text:
Small and gross color. This is a case of you get what you pay for, and a little less. I ordered the ivory color. It in fact is some putrid yellowish tan color resembling pee stains. It’s extremely small and doesn’t reach the box springs on both sides. After struggling and switching it every way to make it fit, hating the color the whole time and thinking I could somehow make it work, I began putting on the pillow shams. They are extremely thin and are nothing more than a pillow case with a little flap on them. And...they don’t fit my king shams either. The ends of the pillows were busting out like my belly after a huge meal. I actually retrieved the small package it came in thinking I had mistakingly ordered a queen. Nope it’s a king/cali king. So I began the tedious task of packing up this set and attempting to put it in the small zipper pack it came in. Did I mention it was vacuum sealed so it fit in the minuscule package? Sorry Amazon, my repacking didn’t go so well
This comforter is a huge miss.
